title: Coefficient clauses for a chosen closed affine chart
statement: For a chosen closed immersion of an affine scheme into an affine space over a field, with the separated finite-type and quasi-compact hypotheses on the ambient and source maps, the two positive finite coefficient levels satisfy the exact closed pushforward, bounded-below dualizing, compact-support composition, and counit-normalization clauses packaged by CoefClosedChartAt.

source.place: Paragraphs 2--3, after the affine closed chart has been chosen

proof.text: Apply the one-level coefficient package separately at m and n; the two-stage conjunction is assembled by the parent theorem.

proof_origin.place: Split coefficient-theoretic clauses from the affine chart existence theorem

from.place: Coefficient clauses after choosing the closed affine chart

lean.statement: theorem coefClosedChartAt_of_closed_chart (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (m n : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmn : m ≤ n) {Y P : Scheme.{u}} (i : Y ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSeparated p] [LocallyOfFiniteType p] [QuasiCompact p] [IsSeparated aY] [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY] (h : i ≫ p = aY) : CoefClosedChartAt l E m hm i k p aY h ∧ CoefClosedChartAt l E n (hm.trans hmn) i k p aY h
